common.comingSoon: This module is still under construction.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Sign in with your email and password.

recover.title: Recover password
recover.subtitle: Answer your security question to set a new password.
recover.emailHint: Enter the email of the account you want to recover.
recover.resetHint: Choose a new password. The old one stops working.
recover.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Close and reopen the app to try again.
recover.successMessage: You can now log in with your new password.

setup.title: Set up your business
setup.subtitle: This is the first time you open the app on this device. Create your owner account and you'll have full control.
setup.recoveryHint: If you ever forget your password, this question will be the only way to recover it. Pick an answer nobody can guess.

home.subtitle: What would you like to do today?

noAccess.title: You can't access the inventory
noAccess.body: Ask the business owner to give you permission to see it.

list.emptyBody: Add the first one to keep track of what you have and what you sell it for.
list.noResultsBody: Try another name, another category, or clear the filters.
list.deleteDescription: "{{name}}" will leave the inventory. Invoices that already list it stay as they are.

form.photoHint: It's resized automatically so it doesn't take up space.

catalog.title: PDF catalog
catalog.description: Pick the products you want to send your customers. It uses what you see now, with the filters applied.
catalog.empty: There are no products to put in the catalog with these filters.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Your details and how you sign in.

identity.title: Your details
identity.description: The name and photo your team will see.
identity.photoHint: JPG or PNG. Cropped and resized automatically.

email.title: Sign-in email
email.description: You sign in with this email. If you change it, use the new one next time.

password.title: Password
password.description: To change it, confirm the one you use now first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Adjust the app to the way your business works.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Categories, units and the running-low alert.

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.description: How you charge and what shows on your invoices.

debts.title: Debts
debts.description: Whether you sell on credit and on what terms.

business.title: My business
business.description: Name, business details and app theme.

roles.title: Users and permissions
roles.description: Who gets into the app and what they can do.

lowQuantity.title: Running-low alert
lowQuantity.description: So you know when to restock before you run out of something to sell.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Group your products so you can find them fast.
categories.emptyBody: Create the first one to group your products: drinks, cleaning, snacks…
categories.deleteDescription: “{{name}}” will be removed from your list. You can create it again any time.

units.title: Units of measure
units.description: How you sell each product: by unit, by kilo, by box…
units.emptyBody: Create the first one to say how you measure what you sell.
units.deleteDescription: “{{name}}” will be removed from your list. You can create it again any time.

exchangeRate.title: Exchange rate
exchangeRate.description: How many bolivars a dollar is worth. Used to charge in dollars and show the equivalent in bolivars.
exchangeRate.emptyTitle: You haven't set a rate yet
exchangeRate.emptyBody: Set it now to charge in dollars and show the bolivar equivalent.
exchangeRate.updateDescription: The current rate is {{rate}} bolivars per dollar. The new value will be kept in the history.
exchangeRate.setDescription: Set how many bolivars a dollar is worth.
exchangeRate.historyDescription: Every value the rate has had, from newest to oldest.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.description: The ways you accept getting paid.
paymentMethods.emptyBody: Create the first one: cash, mobile payment, bank transfer…
paymentMethods.deleteDescription: “{{name}}” will be removed from your list. You can create it again any time.

currency.title: Price currency
currency.description: Choose which of the two amounts shows large. The other stays visible, smaller and in parentheses.
currency.preview: This is how prices will look
currency.noRate: You haven't set the exchange rate yet, so only the dollar price can be shown.

invoice.title: Invoices
invoice.description: How they are numbered and what details get printed on them.
invoice.showBusinessInfoHint: Tax ID, address and phone, as you saved them under My business.

name.title: Business name
name.description: The name shown in the app and on your documents.
name.label: Name

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: The image that identifies your business in the app.
logo.hint: PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB. A square image works best.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Pick the color scheme for the whole app.

info.title: Business details
info.description: The ones that can be printed on your invoices. All optional.

credit.title: Sell on credit
credit.description: Let customers take goods now and pay later. If you turn this off, every sale is paid on the spot.

terms.title: Payment terms
terms.description: How long you give people to pay and how much you let them owe.
terms.limitLabel: Most a customer can owe (in dollars)
terms.noLimit: With 0 there is no limit: a customer can owe any amount.
terms.creditDisabled: You turned credit sales off, so these terms do not apply. Turn them back on above to edit.

members.title: Your team
members.description: Who can get into the app and with what role.
members.recoveryHint: This question will let that person recover their password if they forget it.
members.deleteDescription: “{{name}}” will no longer be able to get into the app. Their email is freed up in case you want to give them access again.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: What each role can do inside the app.
roles.readOnly: Roles are defined by the app and cannot be edited for now.

biometric.reasonEnable: Verify your identity to turn on fingerprint unlock
biometric.reasonLogin: Verify your identity to sign in
biometric.enrollBody: You can use this device's fingerprint or face to sign in without typing your password. You can change this any time from your profile.
biometric.settingHint: Sign in on this device without typing your password.

securityQuestions.pet_name: What was the name of your first pet?
securityQuestions.mother_maiden_name: What is your mother's maiden name?
securityQuestions.birth_city: In which city were you born?
securityQuestions.first_school: What was the name of your first school?
securityQuestions.childhood_friend: What was the name of your childhood best friend?
securityQuestions.favorite_teacher: What was the name of your favourite teacher?

auth.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.superadmin_already_exists: This app already has a super administrator. Log in with your account.
auth.email_already_taken: An account with that email already exists.
auth.role_not_found: The role was not found. Restart the app so the migrations run.
auth.security_question_not_found: The security question you picked is no longer available.
auth.user_without_role: Your user has no role assigned. Contact the administrator.
auth.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.email_not_found: There is no account with that email address.
auth.no_security_question: That account has no security question, so it cannot be recovered this way.
auth.biometric_not_enabled: This account no longer has fingerprint unlock enabled. Sign in with your password.
auth.biometric_failed: We couldn't verify your identity. Please try again.

catalog.duplicate_category: You already have a category with that name.
catalog.duplicate_unit_name: You already have a unit with that name.
catalog.duplicate_unit_abbreviation: That short form is already used by another unit.
catalog.duplicate_payment_method: You already have a payment method with that name.
catalog.not_found: That no longer exists. Reload the screen.
catalog.unit_in_use: You can't delete this unit: some products are measured with it.

team.cannot_create_superadmin: There can only be one owner and one already exists.
team.cannot_modify_superadmin: The owner cannot be given another role or removed.
team.cannot_modify_self: You cannot change your own role or remove your own account.
team.email_already_taken: An account with that email already exists.
team.role_not_found: The role was not found. Restart the app so the migrations run.

profile.current_password_wrong: Your current password is not correct.
profile.email_already_taken: An account with that email already exists.
profile.image_failed: We could not process that image. Try another one.
profile.not_found: We could not find your account. Please sign in again.

inventory.duplicate_product: You already have a product with that name.
inventory.duplicate_sku: That code is already used by another product.
inventory.not_found: That product no longer exists. Reload the screen.
inventory.unit_required: Pick how the product is measured.
inventory.empty_catalog: Select at least one product for the catalog.
inventory.catalog_failed: The catalog couldn't be generated. Try again.
